title: pg chart values (enum guards)
description: Partial schema: constrains the values whose typos silently misconfigure HA. additionalProperties stays open so the rest of values.yaml is unconstrained.

packages.description: Debian/PGDG package names (optionally =version-pinned), apt-get installed into copy-ext/copy-base-ext before the extension-file copy (#303). {major} is substituted with postgresql.majorVersion. Character-class enforced identically by pg.validateExtensionPackages, which also produces the render-time failure message this pattern alone cannot.

aptSources.description: Non-PGDG apt sources (e.g. Pigsty) to add inside copy-ext/copy-base-ext before installing packages (#310) -- for extensions PGDG doesn't package (pgsodium, supabase_vault, pg_graphql, ...). {major} is substituted into aptLine. Requires packages to be non-empty. Character-class enforced identically by pg.validateExtensionAptSources, which also produces the render-time failure message this pattern alone cannot.

extraLibs.description: Exact absolute FILE paths (no trailing /) to additionally copy into a dedicated volume (#309) -- for a transitive shared-library dependency an apt-installed extension needs that Debian places outside /usr/lib/postgresql/<major>/lib (e.g. libsodium.so.23, needed by pgsodium/supabase_vault, lands under the multiarch path instead). Pair with LD_LIBRARY_PATH, which the chart sets automatically on the postgresql container whenever extraLibs is non-empty. Requires packages to be non-empty. Core runtime libraries the server itself links (libc, libssl, libcrypto, libz, libicu*, libstdc++, ...) are refused -- see pg.validateExtraLibs.

env.description: core-v1 EnvVar list for the copy-ext/copy-base-ext init containers (#320) -- chiefly http_proxy, so an install under a default-deny egress policy can go through an in-cell apt mirror instead of permanently allowing apt.postgresql.org/repo.pigsty.io/deb.debian.org. Rendered on the init containers only, never the postgresql container, and only while packages is non-empty (the plain-copy path runs no apt). Requires extensions.enabled and a non-empty packages -- see pg.validateExtensionInitOverrides.

envFrom.description: core-v1 EnvFromSource list for the same two init containers (#320), for proxy settings shared by every release in a namespace. Same requirements as env.

extraVolumes.description: core-v1 Volume list added to the pod for the extension init containers (#320) -- for what env cannot express: an /etc/apt/apt.conf.d snippet or a replacement sources.list, since aptSources only APPENDS source files and cannot rewrite the base sources the images ship. Reusing one of the chart's own volume names is refused at render time (a collision REPLACES the chart's volume rather than merging). Same requirements as env.

extraVolumeMounts.description: core-v1 VolumeMount list applied to both extension init containers (#320). Every entry must name a volume declared in extraVolumes (an absent volume is rejected by the kubelet at apply time, not by helm), and must not mount over /ext-lib, /ext-share or /ext-extra-lib -- the trees the install step copies into. Same requirements as env.

image.description: Prebuilt extension image (#320) -- packages resolved once at build time (see images/pg-extensions/), so pods do a plain cp with no apt and no egress on the pod-start path, and the copy container keeps postgresql.containerSecurityContext instead of the apt path's required runAsUser: 0 (which PSA-restricted namespaces reject). {major} in tag substitutes postgresql.majorVersion. Mutually exclusive with packages and aptSources, and requires a tag or digest -- both enforced by pg.validateExtensionInitOverrides.

log.description: Comma-separated pgaudit classes (read, write, function, role, ddl, misc, misc_set, all), optionally prefixed with - to subtract. Allowlist enforced by the pg.validateAudit template, not this schema.

role.description: Optional pgaudit.role for object-level auditing. Empty disables object auditing.

walLevel.description: replica (default) is enough for physical HA/pgBackRest. logical enables a logical-replication subscriber (#308). The only place to set wal_level -- setting it in postgresql.configuration instead is rejected by pg.validateWalLevel at render time.

syncReplicationSlots.description: Reconcile synchronized_standby_slots to the live standby set on every primary tick (#308). Agent mode + PostgreSQL 17+ only; also requires postgresql.walLevel: logical (enforced at render time).

backend.description: Leadership store: the Kubernetes Lease API (default) or etcd.

control.description: Authenticated control REST API (#276). Dependent rules -- enabled requires tls.existingSecret, restore.enabled requires a non-empty restore.allowedClientCNs -- are template guards, not schema if/then, because helm 3.x does not honor if/then.

port.description: Control-only listener; must not be the 9200 metrics port (a render guard enforces that).

existingSecret.description: Secret with tls.crt, tls.key and ca.crt. Required when control is enabled: mTLS is the only authentication mode.

allowedClientCNs.description: Restore-specific authz verb. An empty list denies every client.

admissionPolicy.description: ValidatingAdmissionPolicy bounding the restore feature's `create jobs` grant by content (#279). Requires Kubernetes >= 1.30 and cluster-scoped create on admissionregistration.k8s.io. Disabling it requires acknowledgeUnbounded=true -- a template guard, not schema if/then.

acknowledgeUnbounded.description: Accept the unbounded namespace-wide job-create grant when the policy is disabled.

command.description: Override the pgpool container startup command. Empty uses the chart default (ipcrm -a reap + exec pgpool).

backendSslmode.description: libpq sslmode for pgpool -> postgres backend connections. Must be >= require when postgresql.tls.require is true.

sslmode.description: libpq sslmode for the exporter -> postgres connection. Must be >= require when postgresql.tls.require is true.

extraEnv.description: core-v1 EnvVar list added to EVERY pgbackrest container (#323) -- the sidecar and pgbackrest-bootstrap init container in the postgresql pod, the backup CronJobs, the restore Job, the validation CronJob. Chiefly KUBECONFIG, to route the backup CronJob's apiserver traffic (EndpointSlice lookup + kubectl exec) through an in-cluster proxy on a cluster whose egress policy denies the apiserver -- without it no backup runs, and stanza-create never runs either, so archive_command fails on every segment. May not reuse a chart-set name; enforced with the rest of the shape by pg.validatePgbackrestPassthrough, which also produces the render-time failure message this schema alone cannot.

extraVolumes.description: core-v1 Volume list added to the pod of every pgbackrest workload (#323): the postgresql pod, the backup CronJobs, the restore Job, the validation CronJob. Names may not collide with a chart volume in any of them, nor with postgresql.extraVolumes / postgresql.extensions.extraVolumes, which share the postgresql pod's volume list.

extraVolumeMounts.description: core-v1 VolumeMount list added to every pgbackrest container (#323). Each entry must reference a pgbackrest.extraVolumes entry and may not shadow a path the containers depend on (PGDATA, /etc/pgbackrest/pgbackrest.conf, /scripts, /work, /tmp) -- see pg.validatePgbackrestPassthrough.

keyType.description: shared = static keys from existingSecret; auto = cloud workload identity / instance credential chain.

uriStyle.description: S3 addressing: host (AWS virtual-host style, default) or path (most non-AWS stores).

targetType.description: PITR target type (pgbackrest --type); empty restores the latest backup + replays all WAL. validation.target is required when set.
PITR target type (pgbackrest --type) applied when bootstrapping an empty PGDATA; empty restores the latest backup + replays all WAL. bootstrap.target is required when set.

mode.description: cronjob = suspended CronJob to clone with `kubectl create job --from`; job = bare Job to render on demand with `helm template -s`.

targetType.description: PITR target type (pgbackrest --type); empty restores the latest backup + replays all WAL. restore.target is required when set.

nameSuffix.description: Appended to the Job name (mode: job), so it must be a valid DNS-1123 label segment; empty = no suffix.
